ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'
name: opentelemetry-instrumentation-redis
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "opentelemetry-instrumentation-redis" %}
{% set version = "0.66b0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/opentelemetry_instrumentation_redis-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6f3f23ac607f25b4d596faeface0f1c6a6c71b014ce4a45d6f4c5ef34c822e2a

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - opentelemetry-api ~=1.12
    - opentelemetry-instrumentation ==0.66b0
    - opentelemetry-semantic-conventions ==0.66b0
    - wrapt >=1.12.1
